title: Body of POST api/import
description: JSON files go in text, a video goes in base64. At most 4 files; the server also caps the body at 24 MiB, a JSON file at 8 MiB and a video at 16 MiB decoded, and accepts only WebM or MP4 videos. File names are labels: the server stores fixed names. The body must be sent as application/json and arrive within 60 seconds. JSON is strict: NaN, Infinity and a body nested too deep are refused. One import runs at a time. The answer is 201 with the manifest; 400 with {error}: the reader's sentence or one of name, category, files, too many files, two <kind> files, <name>: is not valid JSON, <name>: file too large, <name>: not a WebM or MP4 video, <name>: not valid base64, body; 408 body too slow; 413 body too large; 503 busy, try again.
